title: SKE Crystal Plus Refillable Pods 2ml - 2 x Pods
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. This pack of two SKE Crystal Plus Refillable Pods are compatible with the SKE Crystal Plus Mod and offer Crystal Bar fans more freedom than ever before to experiment with flavours. Best used with Nicotine Salts and 50/50 e-liquids, the pods contain a 1.1ohm mesh coil for superb flavour and a discreet yet satisfying amount of vapour. Experience your favourite Crystal Bar flavours with SKE Crystal Nic Salt E Liquids , or fill your pods with any one Nic Salts from our vast collections. The SKE Crystal Plus pod kit is the perfect choice for vapers who want a convenient, pocket-sized device for super-satisfying vaping on the go. It shares the colourful, radiant crystalline design of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar disposable vapes, but without the need to dispose of the whole device thanks to its compatibility with Crystal Plus pre-filled pods (sold separately), which are available in a variety of SKE’s most popular flavours, as well as empty refillable pods. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
